# Maui Mini Session - Full Content Summary

## Identity
Maui Mini Session is the 20-minute portrait offering from the Balter family, the same family behind Wailea Photo. Laurence, Jude, Max, and Solomon Balter photograph sessions personally; the business does not contract sessions to unknown vendors. The family has photographed on Maui for more than 25 years.

Contact: +1-808-298-5188 / info@mauiminisession.com
Address: 3704 S Kihei Rd, Kihei, HI 96753
Website: https://mauiminisession.com/
Parent studio: https://waileaphoto.com/

## Included with every mini session
- 20 minutes of guided photography at a selected Wailea or South Maui shoreline.
- At least 25 naturally edited, high-resolution images.
- Online gallery delivery within 24-48 hours.
- Listed price includes up to five people; additional-person pricing appears in the live booking calendar.
- Current starting price is $299. The live calendar is the authoritative source for availability and checkout pricing.

## Session choices
### Morning Mini Session
Soft morning light, generally cooler air and quieter beaches. Often a strong choice for toddlers, early risers and families adjusting to Hawaii time.
https://mauiminisession.com/morning-mini-session-wailea/

### Sunset Mini Session
Warm evening light, ocean movement and the possibility of a colorful Maui sky. Often a strong choice for older children, adults and couples who prefer golden-hour color.
https://mauiminisession.com/sunset-mini-session-wailea/

### Turquoise-Water Photography
Bright ocean color and a daytime tropical look. Sun, clouds, wind and surface conditions affect the exact shade of water, which cannot be guaranteed.
https://mauiminisession.com/turquoise-water-photography-maui/

## Practical guidance
Sunrise is generally cooler, quieter and less windy; sunset generally offers warmer, more dramatic color. Daily weather varies. Families should choose the time when children are naturally happiest.
https://mauiminisession.com/sunrise-vs-sunset-family-photos-maui/

Twenty minutes is often enough for families with up to five people who want one location and one outfit. A longer session may be better for large groups, many combinations, multiple locations, clothing changes, or children who need a long warm-up.
https://mauiminisession.com/20-minute-maui-photo-session-children/

## FAQ
What is included? Twenty minutes, calm direction, and at least 25 naturally edited high-resolution photographs.

How fast is delivery? Within 24 to 48 hours after the session.

What if children do not pose? They do not need to. Sessions use movement, simple prompts and natural interaction.

What if weather changes? Clients may reschedule before the session when Maui weather is not cooperating. Conditions change quickly and the photographer helps make a practical call.

Where do sessions take place? At selected shoreline locations in Wailea and South Maui. Exact meeting details are provided after booking.

Who photographs the session? Laurence, Jude, Max, or Solomon Balter. Meet them at https://mauiminisession.com/our-photographers/.
